text: This is our go-to pizza place. We love the upside down pizza. Their wings and Greek salad are delicious, too! And they're always friendly...from  ordering over the phone to the delivery person.
Can't beat the happy hour. 1/2 pizzas and draft beer. By far the best za i've had in the city.
We visited for Mother's Day and it was worth the wait.  If you are not big on breakfast food like myself, try the chicmen and waffles
Second time here and the food was great. The service took a little longer than usual, seems like they need more help. Other than that, I love this restaurant!
This place was amazing. Our waiter Josh was awesome and so personable. The food from the appetizers to the entrees was sooo tasty. We will definitely come back.

Placed an order through the app at lunch time and you have to checked a time. I checked 11:30. When  I tried to submit ...   it said time lapsed so I had to pick the next available time which is 11:45. I wait around at Starbucks at the other end of the strip mall to kill time then I go down to girodonos about 10 minutes before the time and the guy said go tell the kitchen to start making the sandwich. I was like what .. I placed the order at 11:10, there were 2 people sitting in the resturant so they were not busy, then boss says well actually u are early it is not suppose to be ready till 11:45. Really dude the reason people order ahead is because they are probably on a hurry... might want to fix that little glitch in the app so people can click asap

This place was simply amazing. We were craving Italian and Little Nonnas was definitely more then we expected.  It is AUTHENTIC Italian cuisine, don't expect to get your basic fettuccine Alfredo from here! The garlic bread was so fresh and had a great taste. We chose the spaghetti and meatballs and the shrimp scampi! Then we completed our meal with the tiramisu which I rightly recommend you save room for! We will be coming back next time we are in town!

Have done take out here for years as it's hands down, the best Indian good in town. The chicken  saag is soooo good along with many, many others. Now the interior of the restaurant is updated and very nice to take the family. Keep up the great work serving delicious food!!

Never had pizza quite like this. Every single bite, of any section of the square pie, was incredible. The caramelized crust and bottom of the pizza were crunchy. The dough was somewhat chewy. The sauce is $#^!ing delicious dude. The cheese melted perfectly. I savored every bite, and I can't stop thinking about getting another pie. That flavor, so savory, really sticks with you. Not necessarily in ranking order, as the square pie is quite different, but Beddia and Gutt are best in the city no doubt.

We have been wanting to try this place out for some time now and COVID provided us an opportunity we couldn't pass up. Driving by the lot was transformed to a literal outdoor garden of "eatin"  tables and stand umbrellas took up the area where cars once parked. Plenty of tables each table-clothed and numbered.  Atop each a silver champagne bucket to collect cast off napkins sugar packet and straw wrappers nicely so that the warm breeze didn't blow them away.

Waitstaff was on top of things masked and ready to serve.  No limited menu or paper plates/ plastic cups here which seems to be the norm around the area lately.  Our food was prepared quickly, served hot and was more than enough to satisfy.

A lovely breakfast on a beautiful day outdoors and safe was well enjoyed and we will defiantly be back.
Excellent food, best in the area! Delicious Nan basket, butter chicken, spinach paneer & cauliflower. Loved everything. Service is great, couldn't be nicer. Worth the drive from New Hope!!!!
Good, solid Chinese food.  Convenient pick up window for Togo orders made fast and accurate.  A staple restaurant at my house.

This was my first dining out experience during COVID.  The tables were spaced far apart and servers wearing masks.  I have Celiac and often struggle with Italian and hidden gluten.  This dinner was a nice, I ordered Chicken Parm with veggies, not breaded. The waiter was very helpful with the menu, even mentioned his girlfriend has Celiac which made me feel like he was taking it seriously. This was a date so I like the gluten free conversation to be as seamless as possible. This restaurant is BYOB which is a fun way to pair delicious food with wine or beer that you love.

Do you know how you can tell how awesome In-N-Out Burger is?  I think the lines coming out the street to the stop light speaks for itself.  

I've been eating here since I was a child and there's a lot of tastes associated with childhood but all that aside, you will not find a fresher burger anywhere.  Do you know how fast the turn over rate is for their ingredients is?  Weekdays, weekends... they are busy 24/7.  They're like the DMV for hamburgers.  Coming back to my point- their ingredients don't have time to spoil and they cook burgers so fast that they don't need to freeze their meat.

What's special about their burger is how it all comes together.  You can have the freshest ingredients in the world, but putting them together in a balanced way is what makes a burger outstanding.  In-N-Out does it with ease.  No matter how you alter the burger to your taste- protein style without the bun, animal style with grilled onions and pickles, or 4x4 style with 4 patties, you cannot go wrong with taste.

The cherry on top is In-N-Outs fast and friendly service. You would think that there are thousands on minions working inside. They are just so fast and efficient that a line never scares me away when I'm craving burgers.

Did I mention how affordable their burgers are?  You can go all out for the whole family and it will most likely not break the bank.

Notes:
-Why only 4 stars?  The low reviews are from people that are trying to shoo away others so they don't have to wait any longe

This location sucks, after trying for 10 minutes to get in often being crowded road and into their tiny little parking lot with a drive-through wrapped all around the corner with 20 cars in it just to find out the lobby is closed, what a joke. Are we that afraid, if we're willing to risk Taco Bell obviously were not afraid of Covid!
Really great food! Would definitely recommend. Delivery is fast and food arrived warm. Very satisfied. Would recommend bbq chicken flatbread :)
The service was good! food was not great, but this place is overrated for the price they have they should have better food. The food was cold... Just not a good experience.

This place is so unique! I love how many Comoros you can pick from. My favorite is the classic meatball with bourbon bbq sauce, which is good. Also love the mashed potatoes. We called about 10 minutes before we got here and they set us up with a table for 10 immediately. Daevice was incredible kind. When the mashed potatoes were going to take an extra 30 minutes, they not only comped the potatoes but also brought us free dessert! Speaking of which, highly recommend the banana pudding. It was delish.

I had the pleasure of going to this restaurant yesterday for my birthday.  I loved everything about this place. The ambiance was perfect and the food was great. They even gave me a cake to celebrate. Definitely will be going back soon.

I e eaten here many times never again, ordered campechana fries and waited forever in drive thru and they finally came out ( with no fork! ). And the pastor was severely undercooked just based on looks and texture. Disgusting. I literally had to refry the whole dish in a pan at home and it's inedible

Wow! Now this place has the meats, or vegan friendly options! Mitchell's was a treat for the mouth and nose. This cute little deli has hipsters working hard for perfectly meshed sandwiches, salads,  and soups. If u r a nashville resident who loves sandwiches then take a trip and fight for a parking space at this heaven of a deli

We planned on eating lunch there but the place seemed a bit unorganized considering Covid. We got 2 slices of key lime pie to go and it truly was the best I have ever had. I would try the restaurant at another time.

This restaurant has progressively gotten worse in the last year. It's always dirty inside. When I say firstly, the trash is full, the tables and floors are sticky and the bathrooms are gross. The service is slow and inconsistent. Today, I've been sitting in my car at curbside pickup and I've seen someone walk in, order food at the counter and walk out with food. My order isn't big either. Finally my app checked in to see if I was still waiting. Then a few minutes go by and the employee brings out my food. Goes to the car next to me first (also arrived after me) and she was pleasant and apologized for the wait. The employees are always sweet and kind. The service and accuracy is honestly worse than most. I was half way down the road and saw my drink was wrong too. It was a very sweet tea with ice. Come on! It's really easy to leave ice out of a cup!
My bride and I did the Romborer dinner tonight and it was very good. We were ok definitely go back and try the regular menu

Wow! I have driven past this place for years and every time said to myself "I need to try that place!" And tonight we finally did! I am a HUGE fan of all things hot chicken, fried chicken, chicken tenders, etc. and this place did not disappoint. 

I got the jumbo tenders (3 large tenders on top of a piece of toast and topped with a pickle) and a side of the mac & cheese and Parmesan fries. I highly recommend this meal if you're unsure what to try! The fries are a very generous portion and they go great with the hot honey dipping sauce. My fiancé got the chicken sandwich with the mashed potatoes which were also very good! 

As far as spice level, we both tried the "Tweener" which was a 4/6 on the spice chart. This was a great choice if you like hot, but don't like runny nose/crying hot. We both think we could probably handle the "hot" which is the next level up next time we go.
Absolutely love the breakfast! Portions are large and service is speedy, so many options you won't know which to choose! Definitely a must go !
Very thirsty, my urine was yellow before coming here. Waited 57 minutes for a refill. Very dehydrated, my pee is becoming solid. Happy about free pie tho.

The best, amazing this place is definitely one of the best yeah three times best! Who got something to say! 
I'm from jersey will be back definitely
Can't wait! Chicken was rocking! When I go back I want a little of everything!  Mrs D hooked it up! Greatly appreciated, ty 7/27/2020 love truly from your guy's John & Tan

This is our favorite place. We would eat here at least twice a month pre-pandemic. Now we order delivery every chance we get. Our favorite is the carne asada burro, and we like the chicken burros too. We love all the tacos and Sonoran dogs too. When you order delivery, they send along the fresh limes, salsas, and roasted jalapeños; if you want onions, radishes, or avocado salsa you have to ask for them.

OK , so I finally made it into this place and I'm glad I did. The place is rather unassuming and doesn't really have a decor to speak of, but it really doesn't need to because the burgers are the shining star here.
Service was polite and prompt, and though my burger took awhile to come out it was so worth the wait! I ordered the dry heat burger, this thing was messy as all get out, but damn was it delicious! My only complaint would be the canned nacho cheese, a homemade cheese sauce would have really put it over the top.
I ordered my burger medium rare and it was perfectly cooked, the meat has a great texture and is high quality, absolutely juicy and delicious! The bun was toasted and firm, and somehow held up under all the toppings!
This burger also has quite a kick so be prepared if you order it! I also had homemade tots which were pretty solid although a bit salty and quite peppery! They could use a tad bit more cheese as well, but they are served piping hot, and there's plenty of them!
Overall this was a damn fine meal, and I definitely recommend this restaurant, especially to burger lovers!

Best barbecue I've had in awhile and we were surprised to find it in Tucson! If you can, make sure to get the 4 meats so you can sample all of this goodness, you won't regret it! The Mac & Cheese is what dreams are made of. We will definitely be back!
One of the best places to grab a bite & listen to great live music before or after a Titans game. Great space - each level  is different so no stress deciding where to sit!

Good service and the food is better than a Sherri's or Denny's but nothing special.
A little overpriced for the atmosphere and quality of food.

As I sat waiting for our vet today I watched a Casa Fiesta employee wipe down every table, on the table crowded veranda, with ONE cloth and no spray or rinsing agent in sight.  His mask around his neck, not covering his mouth. This NOT what I would consider a sanitizing or appropriate social distancing. I am sad about what I saw because, due to veranda seating, i wanted to have lunch there, which would have been our first restaurant visit since February...
Amazing delicious ice cream and great outdoor atmosphere. Sport Channel on outside TV and fir pit and fans. Staff is amazing nice.

I LOVE this place. One of the best vegan spots in Philly. It is always busy but I've never had to wait for a spot at the counter, they are super efficient. Their tofu scramble is unreal. I usually get the breakfast burrito, but I'm also a fan of the bagel breakfast sandwich. Really anything here is good!! The coffee is good too, essential for a diner. I'm a fan of their chai lattes. I live maybe 40 miles out of Philly but whenever I'm in the city I try and make a stop here. My omnivore boyfriend also loves it here; he gets jealous if I go without him! Highly recommend this perfect spot for some yummy, no fuss vegan food in a cute diner-vibe space.

We are always on the look out for good chicken places when we travel.  This stop outside of Nashville is a must. Chicken was juicy with great flavor.  It has a levels of heat so it worked for our family. Something for all.  My husband and daughter said the beans anD Mac-n- cheese were great!   I am a fry kinda gal and they were good too.  Must visit!

The quality of food is poor, My stomach was upset for hours after eating lunch here. General Tso's chicken with chow menu.... sorry but I would not recommend this spot unless you need a colon cleanse.

Big Cheese Glen Mills, go between meal rushes when Melinda is bored and she'll make whatever you want. Rolls and sauces are made in house. I drew on my inner Jcohl, co-host Dining on a Dime podcast, and got the big cheesesteak combined with the special cheesesteak on a garlic roll. This was a flavorful taste explosion in my mouth and well you know the rest.  I liked the cheesesteak so much I stayed for the Cinna Knots with Homemade Icing. Sorry, I only have video of Cinna Knots.  You can see video on Philadelphia Cheesesteak Adventure YouTube channel.  Treat your taste buds to the Big Cheese, new location in Boothwyn is also open.

Wow!  Drove from NJ to go to Sonnys for a cheesesteak, but that was closed due to a maintenance issue.   I asked a local where to go instead and he simply said "Brothers" down the street.  Well...wow!  Great cheesesteak and plenty of seating!  A spectacular rebound and now we have a new favorite!

A taste of nostalgia on the southside. Best root beer in the city!! And I love a good root beer. The onion rings are also mighty tasty. I went rogue and didn't get their tenderloin, and chose a cheeseburger instead. I'll have to go back and give the tenderloin a try.

If any more of my friends hear about Babo one more time I think they might take me out. I cannot say enough about this place. Very chill vibe, you can order food at the counter and sit at a table, or order at the bar. They have a wide variety of options including vegan and vegetarian. They have a nice variety of beers and sakes, and their frozen drink on tap is really delicious. Food is very affordable and portion sizes are really good. The food is absolutely delicious. I love the pork katsu, the sauces are so delicious and the meat is cooked to perfection. All the staff is super friendly and welcoming! I love getting here as often as I can, and I cannot wait to make my way back!

Let me tell you guys a story. I ate a Cheesesteak from Woodrow's and it blew my mind. End of story. 

I'd seen this place on top ten lists and videos on YouTube and this and that, and I decided that I had to try it. Not because people said it was amazing (which they did), but because they said it was unique. 

See, at the time of this review, I'm 34 years old, born and raised in Philly. I've had all the cheesesteaks. Tony Luke's, John's, Chinks, Chubby's, Steve's, Dalessandro's, whatever. So, whenever I hear someone say "You gotta try this Cheesesteak!" I'll typically say "No I don't." because (to me) there's not much more you can do with cheese, a roll, and some steak meat. 

But shiiiiiiit! Their own homemade Truffle wiz and a little cherry pepper mayonnaise completely flipped the script. It's like nothing I've ever tasted in my life. 

About four years ago, I moved out of Philly and into Jenkintown. I tried Woodrow's for the first time in April of this year. It's now September, and I've made the drive through all that traffic on 76 and center city to get Woodrow's at least five times since then, but my family only knows about three of those trips. Lol it's worth all the gas money and screaming at idiots on the road to get my hands on this food.

Last thing before I go: over the summer, my cousin suggested we try the Cubano, and I genuinely may like it even more than the cheesesteak. Ridiculous.

First off, I'm ashamed to say that I haven't been here in a while. This is no fault other than my own. When I picked up my food, the staff inside was personable and things were ready to go. 

The scent of the food permeating through my car made it difficult NOT to break in and start eating while driving. Thankfully, my commute wasn't far so I was in good hands. The moment I was through the door, I opened the box of wings with passion and leaned into what are some of the meatiest wings I've had in town. They didn't last long. The wings were enough to tide me over for a moment and made for a great appetizer. 

Next, the pizza which was full of flavor that sent a clear message: this is going to hold up and be even better for breakfast. 

If you haven't had #Pizzava in a while, or ever, do yourself, and your family, a solid and get their food in your system sooner rather than later. If you're a fan of convenience, visit them online at www.pizzava.com and place your order. 

Thanks for taking a moment to read this.

I came here for the Spicy Ramen challenge. As I was not required to sign a waiver (unless I accepted one electronically without my knowledge) I was not expecting the sheer pain and displeasure I experienced. Overlooking this, their food looks good. The interior is bright and vibrant. As I have not been defeated by a Spicy food challenge before I am giving 5 stars pending my return to try their normal menu items. Ya'll got me good.

Awesome Pizza
The upside down pie is the BEST
I was gonna drive downtown to one of the Insta hyped pizza places but needed a quick fix before the football games started. The pie was awesome and ready in 15 minutes as promised.
No kid friendly not even high chair sorry not good if you don't care about kids this is not a good restaurants for families

Luke was connected to my hotel, so after a travel day and working, I decided to eat here instead of going out. I was NOT impressed and wouldn't patronize again. The best thing about my visit was the glass of Malbec and the fact that they were abiding by social distancing protocols. I'm sensitive to slower business and lean staffs due to covid, but that shouldn't change service. As a lone diner, I was seated at a table for two. I sat for what seemed like longer than normal without anyone coming  to greet my table. I even started looking around for a server after putting down my menu (the signal that a patron is ready to order -- I was a server in high school and college). One server came to pour water only, gave a short greeting and that was it. But, I was surprised to hear him introduce himself to the table of three men sitting next to me. When the server finally came to take my order, again, no greeting or introduction, he started with "do you have any questions". I asked for a recommendation and he did a good job providing an explanation to help decide between my three choices. 

I ordered the shrimp and grits... it was ok, nothing exciting, not terrible, but I felt like it was missing some flavor. 

Finally, I asked for the bill and manager... I told him all of this above and he apologized. May seem like nothing, but again, being that I've been a server, I expect more. I'm a standard 20% tipper, this time, I left 15. I love NOLA and the food, but I'm rarely disappointed.

Sushi was good but overpriced. The atmosphere is definitely nice for a weekend evening or special occasion. The restaurant always seems to be pretty empty though. I recommend the tempura shrimp sushi roll.

Sabrina's near the Art Museum has always been a fun spot for us.  Even after all the restrictions from covid, they still are making it work. Love the new outdoor space and sitting in the sun!  Staff is still as awesome as they were before all this craziness!  Looking forward to eating again when the inside is open and back up!

Honestly, the hogs for a cause wings changed my life. They're SO good. We were super hungry and went for the  pick your own meats and sides. Honestly, it was enough to feed 6 or more people. We were eating it for days afterwards. The only thing to note is the Mac and cheese is made with velveeta cheese so it's super thick and heavy. Definitely will be back soon!

Menu on the website does not include pictures or a description of ingredients. After ordering and having the entrees delivered without rice I called and was told that it's all sold separately. Wow...

Too expensive for the items if it's not even the full meal.

Went for Saturday brunch...the only option at this time is the El Techo space in this location. Drinks were different and good. Food was fresh and tasty. Portion sizes were appropriate for tasting different things...almost like tapas. And were also priced rt. The El Techno space is modern and spacious with big windows show casing the Philly tall buildings. So overall nice setting. The service was good....wait staff was warm and attentive. Definitely worth the visit.
Only downside....I wanted to try their tacos that are made from heirloom corn, but they serve this only in their restaurant and not in El Techo
Great prices hidden gem for us! If you haven't tried it and you love seafood and sushi, it is definitely a must. They also have burgers and things for kids. Amazing food!

More restaurants need to take notice! These healthier food options are trending. Organic is better. Vegan options veggie options are awesome! Check this place they are legit good and healthy! Air fried foods, wraps, veggie dogs, burgers too and def get some cookies!

I'm a bit torn on my review. I love Ramen and wanted to like this place better but I didn't love it. I got their regular Ramen which comes with ground beef and pork belly. My pork belly was just a bunch of chewy fat which is a texture that really turns me off. My Ramen broth tasted a little bitter. I barely ate any of it. My boyfriend got the broth-less Ramen with pork and he enjoyed it. He doesn't mind the chewy meat texture. I do think it's authentic and maybe I or they had an off night, so I might try them again if I can figure out a way to never get chewy pork belly again. I wish they offered a little more variety for the Ramen dishes. We got a dish that was Japanese, fried balls of chicken for an appetizer. 
The prices were average for Ramen and the guy who took our to go order was very pleasant. There was moderate marks wearing and social distancing. It's a small restaurant, so not a lot of room and people weren't wearing masks at the tables because they are eating and drinking. They only had a couple of small benches outside but had a nice patio area where they could offer outside seating. I'm not sure why they don't take advantage of it. I wouldn't feel comfortable eating here because there's not enough room to social distance.
We did carry out with BOGO chicken parm on Thursday night. Wonderful. Waited on the patio with Sangria. My wife said the best ever.
Amazing donuts. Fresh, great variety, outstanding taste and very large. With covid you need to order ahead for curbside pickup. If you are looking for great donuts I would get your order in.

Idiots!!!!! Order 2 breakfast sandwich's and 3 hash brown waited 15 mins on side .. both breakfast sandwich's were  missing Sausage!!! One had no cheese and no sausage just biscuit! Call complain I get hung up on!

This Midtown estabishment that shares the up and coming Virgina Street Strip is more than Eats!  Here you have the delish variety from calorie conscious to not-so, to hecka and I mean hecka endless lists of adult beverages including Whiskey babe!!!  The cocktails are yumsters and the Beer is draft!!!  The service is outstanding and nothing less.  Awesome servers Isabel and Kristina and Toby the owner set the standards. Thank you!!!
Great options for carry out! The falafel sandwich was super flavorful. They were out of one appetizer, and were very apologetic. Overall, good service and friendly staff.

This place is horrible. Not only did they get my order wrong the first time I went by to get my order corrected I ordered a sausage egg and cheese Mc griddle they only gave me sausage and then when I returned it they only had a cheese to eat still no Eggs this is ridiculous don't eat here

Beautiful decor. Nice, relaxing atmosphere. The fireplace makes it extra cozy! Excellent food. Even better bartender!  Micah was very attentive and quite knowledgeable of the spirits. The Snowflake martini was delicious! Definitely try the sweet potato bisque and edamame dumplings!
Was very good, better than expected. Not floppy, affordable, clean facility. Will definitely be back. I really liked the sauce, great ratio to cheese. Crispy crust.

Everything here was amazing! The staff is so kind and work quick. Our server's name was Justin and he was awesome! I had the bacquezo omelet and it was well worth the calories! My friend ordered the Eggnog waffle and it was off the charts delicious! Make sure you get on the waitlist before you head over to the restaurant for it makes for almost no wait when you arrive! I will be returning to this location soon!
I absolutely love the theme they have going on here with naming a lot of their menu items after scary movies. It's a very fun enviroment for sure. Some of the best burgers in town!
Super busy. Food expensive but pretty good. You order everything separate which ends up costing almost $10 per person. A little much considering it's just a cheeseburger and fries.

Been there twice now (pre-covid and during covid) loved both times!! The taco flight is where it's at aka 10 tacos for $35. Also, do yourself a favor and get the mango salsa... MY FAVORITE. I literally want to order a gallon of it to go. Otherwise, great service, good menu and drink selection.

My wife and I have been in New Orleans all of 4 days, but we both agree that Luke is one of the best restaurants we've ever eaten at, and for sure the best meal we've had on our first trip to Louisiana! We were taking a long walk and were deciding between Luke and Tressane (or however else it's spelled), and we're so glad the coin flip led us here.

We started off with the duck/rabbit pate and the fried boudin balls. To be honest, I still have absolutely zero idea what boudin is. Sometimes it'll be like pulled pork, other times a patty, and here it was like a fried hushpuppy or arancini, but regardless, it was still delicious! Not sure what the yellow sauce was that came with it (it was foamy and tasted like butter and mellowed out hollandaise sauce), but the sauce helped add another level to the boudin balls.

The pate was to die for. They brought out a giant jar of the stuff along with a full board of large-grain mustard, pickles, a pickled radish or some other vegetable, and two types of vegetable jams. When we ran out of crostinis (the jar is HUGE people) our waiter brought us some more bread. The pate is rich and has the lovely iron-like flavor you would find in liver dishes. Combined with the acidic and sweet flavors of the rest of the board, the pate was perfect. I would strongly recommend it, as long as you don't absolutely despise liver.

For our main course, we ordered the shrimp and grits to share, and the kitchen graciously divided the dish into two small skillets

The worst Italian food I have ever had. Don't go there.  I ordered the lamb through Uber and it's tasteless and no flavor and burnt as well.  The salad was ok.  Just a horrible experience.   Called them.  The only response I got is : we can't do anything about it and bye.   

So here a the review for you. If you don't believe it.  Go there and ask for the tasteless lamb and pasta

Biggest bang for your buck! I had the small bowl, which is three scoops of protein. I got down on the salmon, tuna and spicy tuna. The spicy tuna was just the right heat. All the veg and toppings were fresh and an awesome texture to compliment the fish. A must is the fried garlic!

Support this place!! I'll definitely be a regular.
good jersey food.  the delivery driver was awesome!

I have been to this pokeworks at least four time. I like their poke and they are one of the best poke around. During the pandemic, they take precautions for the food and customers. They allow you to come in or call in the order. They set the six feet boundary from the food counter. They did display each topping and protein with identification tag. So you can tell them what you want. 

We got the regular bowl with two protein. Their choice of base is great because the have variety. I alway like their sushi rice and kale noodle as base. The protein selection also large. I like to get scallops and the ahi tuna. The other protein include spicy salmon, salmon, albacore tuna, shrimp, chicken, tofu. The beauty is their have the mixed in, sauce selection and protein together mixed up before the put on top of the base then add topping. This is good practice. The sauce you can select different type. I like poke sauce and Thai sweet chili. 

Pokeworks has reward program. You might want to sign up.

I wonder if not that many people know about this place yet! So glad to find this place so we don't have to drive to South Philly anymore! Same taste, same portion of food and same price! We will go back again! :)

This place is nothing short of amazing! Everytime my friend has an event and orders from here I am in my car all the way from brandon full of excitement to eat whatever she orders. The chicken marsala,the lemon chicken pasta just everything is wonderful! Thank you for providing such excellence and happiness to my belly everytime!!

Fantastic dinner in this little family owned restaurant. We had the tasting menu and it was awesome. Everything was unique, beautifully prepared and very tasty. The staff was incredible and that's what made the night. Very friendly and sincere. I wish more restaurants were like this. We'll be back!
Just got the green chicken curry and pad Thai, soo good! Rich and delicious! Highly recommend!

Drove by, they looked pretty interesting, went in. Nice place very clean, was stuck between two wraps and Joanne behind recommended the Caesar salad. Definitely was not disappointed! The woman behind the register was very cheerful took my order quickly. The food got out even faster! Definitely coming here again soon.

Our new favorite find! Make sure you call ahead for a reservation. To think it has been her the whole time. My husband had the porterhouse. Wow. It came to us still sizzling from the flames He could cut it with a fork and the flavor was outstanding.  I had the sampler plate. The ribs were a little dry for me but the chicken was perfectly moist and flavorfully tender. The steak was good.
The salad bar was excellent. The cowboy beans ,almost as good as Grandma. The bread felt soft, but was tough. The baked potatoes were the best. The service was excellent and attentive. The food came promptly.
My absolute favorite restaurant in Dunedin! Food is always fresh, great specials and fantastic service! We eat here regularly and enjoy it every time.

LOVE Pho Long!! The pho is always fantastic -- flavorful broth and tender brisket. I've dined in with them once a year ago, and I love their chic interior. Recently I have also really appreciated their COVID protocol for ordering and delivery. Their delivery man set up my order right outside the door on a crate and very politely maintained social distance while I signed the receipts. It might seem small, but these deliberate efforts showcase a level of care that I've really grown to appreciate from restaurants during this pandemic. The staff is all kind and helpful in every interaction I've had with them. If you have a consistent hankering for pho like I do, please support this wonderful business!

The food is brought hot and serving portion is plenty and delicious and the service is great and we never have to wait too long to have them bring our food and the music is not too loud. So it's great overall. No complain here. I've been here on the weekends when it's been crowded as well as during the week. I wish other places would be like this place.

Family friendly environment. Nice ambiance and good location. Service here really isn't shaped out like it's supposed to be. I hardly make a conscious decision to come here and eat but a friend of mine recommended it has changed and it's better so instead of going to my favorite place to eat I chose here and I was about to walk out first off there was a 28 min wait then when I finally got to sit and order my server dropped water and hard bread at the table then never came back so I started to walk out and ask for a manager another server told me he would take care of me so I returned to the table and sat and I asked for fresh bread and still didn't get it then Derrick my new server forgot I ordered drinks then I'm sitting there asked for a manager. Tim comes out and calmly i explained my issue to him, he listened and responded he made sure everything was good and then I went in as it was getting super hot and asked Tim to get my drink done properly which he did. The bartender however is rude. It's funny that they are in the customer service industry
I love their sashimi! Very fresh! One of my favorites in St.Pete! Friendly, attentive staff! Check it out if you are downtown!
Best date place to eat sushi. Price was good food was even better. Come and enjoy this wonderful food called sushi! My girlfriend was very excited to come to this place, definitely worth the trip.
This food is amazing! Great service! Flavors are on point. Nice atmosphere. Try it out!

Great family who takes care of everybody! Food is wonderful, wing it Wednesday is always something to look forward to and their home made blue cheese it the best! Plenty of TV's, quick service and great quality.

Was excited to come here, especially with all the great reviews! We called around 1pm on Saturday, and the order was done in 20 minutes. 

Tried the pizza $ while good, we didn't find it to be spectacular. The tomato sauce was really sharp and good, and the crust super doughy. However,  a lot of the crust was burnt and flaking off, and left a slightly ashy taste in my mouth. 

The location is great- there are tables outside that you can eat at, and Rori's ice cream next door!

Amazing sandwiches! These people know how to make a sandwich. Fresh wholesome ingredients and made with love. Got the Rolando which was the best sandwich I have ever had. Their coconut macaroons were fire!!! The service was great! Abby is an excellent host!

Came here today to try a poke bowl. After trying a poke bowl at a newly opened restaurant in another town a few days ago, I found that I yet again had a craving for a poke bowl, but wanted to see if anywhere else near me served them. This place definitely does a lot more than poke bowls (sushi and other dishes), but this review is based only upon their poke bowl-making.

First off, I have to say that after going to this place, I was forced to lower my review for the other place I tried as this place brought the standard up! I ordered a poke bowl with a brown rice base, ahi tuna, salmon, cucumber, red onion, cilantro, seaweed salad, spicy aoli, lotus chips, wonton crisps, and onion crisps. I have to note that they do lose credit for having not actually provided the onions and cilantro. I couldn't find them in my bowl.

BUT, the price was great for the portion size. Not excessively portioned, but also not excessively priced... for a total of $10.55 after tax, I got a delicious poke bowl with two proteins. Comparably, I paid $13.25 at the place I went to a few days ago for a VERY similar if not identical bowl of food, so almost $3 more there. And in the places I've been to in NYC, this bowl often runs $15 and up. So, I have to give them lots of credit for their reasonable pricing.

Despite being cheaper than a lot of places I've been to, it did not mean that they skimped on ingredients or ingredient quality. The food was so fresh-tasting and absolutely delicious. I wanted to kee

Went here on a Saturday morning about 11:30 glad we went that early.

Everything was fresh a bit of a crowd but not bad at all.

We sat down and ordered our drinks and went straight for the buffet. 

They had a lot of options, a full salad bar, meats section, sushi section, soups, fruits and deserts along with fondue chocolate.

With my little picky eater there were items that my little one ate, so we will definitely be back.

Never been here before, went in for lunch today by myself and sat at the bar. My food ended up taking a while to get to me (maybe 40m) but the bartender and manager were so professional and apologetic (and the food was delicious) so I didn't even mind. 100% would recommend and will be back.

My fiancé and I came here on our way back from Paso Robles. It has great reviews so we decided to give it a shot and we were not disappointed! 

The spot is right next to the batting cages. There's parking in the same area as the batting cages. We found parking right away since it was rainy so the batting cages were pretty much empty. 

We both got the triple shot, a side of chips and salsa and a beach ball. I got the bahn mi, gangum and the carne asada tacos. They were all pretty good. I updated favorite was the gangum style. The meat was well cooked and the slaw was perfectly seasoned. 

The beach ball was good. It was pretty big so I'm glad my fiancé and I split one. The spicy mayo was definitely needed though because it felt a little bland without it. It comes with wonton chips on the side. 

We didn't realize the tacos came with chips, otherwise we wouldn't have gotten the extra chips and salsa. 

Everything was pretty good, but fair warning - their hot sauce salsa is HOT. Like habanero pepper hot. I like hot sauce but that was a little much. 

Overall everything was good. Prices were fair and a great deal. We'd be back again if we were in the area!
You will have to wait a long time - and they dint take reservations. But it's worth it. The pork belly taco, guacamole, and a house margarita will make the worth it.

This lunch was worth the trip. In the Garden District across from Lafayette Cemetery, Commander's Palace lived up to the legacy. We split the turtle soup and duck leg confit for lunch. The kitchen split each plate for us making it easier to share. The duck melted in my mouth and  the grits were the perfect compliment. The turtle soup had a good spice and unique flavor. The highlight of the meal was dessert with the strawberry shortcake with tart and sweet berries atop a light and fluffy biscuit. The staff worked like a well oiled machine giving us excellent service and adding to a great time. Our meal ended with an unplanned trip through the kitchen which added to the experience. Everyone was friendly and courteous. I highly recommend dining here.

Tried their pizza (with veggie toppings) for the the first time based on a friend's recommendation and it is delicious! The crust is thin and tasty.. the sauce is not acidic (just the way I like it) and toppings are fresh (not pickled ones from can). Will be back again and try other items..

Dining during Covid can be a bit disconcerting; however the restaurant has done everything in their power to make it's patrons feel comfortable and secure, with that said:

The drinks:
They don't have any Reislings or a wine comparable, so I opted for The Love Mule- light and refreshing but the level of alcohol is virtually non existent. 

The food:
Fried Green Tomatos: delish! The breading was flavorful, the dish comes with a pimento cheese and bread and butter pickles- all eaten together, is such a beautiful blend of flavors and textures - you have to try it, best fried Green Tomatoes I've had outside of Charleston, Sc

The lobster spaghetti: not very what I'd hoped. I think the initial disinterest came from it not being served hot it was barely warm and the flavor was lacking. I anticipated it to be packed with Rich buttery flavor as the lobster bisque is the sauce, but it wasn't. In addition, the bits of lobster didn't add anything to the dish as whole. I was most excited about this dish upon ordering but it fell flat.

The Salmon: Again we have the issue with the temperature of this dish. The salmon was cooked perfectly about a medium to medium well and it was atop of a broth with mixed Asian vegetables. The flavor for the broth as well as the Salmon wasnt exciting. Seeing on the menu how the Salmon was described as Vietnamese and caramel- I anticipated something a little more in line with the rich flavors of a traditional Carmalized Vietnamese Salmon bUt this fell flat.

Wings are a big deal for me. And for my money, the two best places in Nashville for wings are Brother Z's and Peg Leg Porker.  At Brother Z's, they are perfectly crispy, with lots of flavor options (I'm partial to the dry rubs like lemon pepper and garlic pepper).  Bonus points - Brother Z himself is one of the friendliest guys I've met in this town.  Give him a call and he will take care of you.
Wow! Their drunken chicken is delicious. Medium heat was just that! A great amount of flavor and spice all within my tolerance. Will definitely be back. Service was attentive and extremely quick.

Covered outdoor seating during COVID is a plus, especially if trying to catch shade to beat the heat or shield from the rain. Caught up with a frannn for lunch today. She was surprised I had never been here before since the establishment has been a go to for a lot of our mutual friends.  Have to say my sammie, the melt, was a gooey mess. But sometimes that's what makes the best sandwiches lol. The bbq chicken breast was thrown between two luscious cranberry multi grain slices of bread and dressed with tomato slices, bacon strips, Gouda, fried onions then doused with honey bbq aioli. I was able to eat half of it before the bread started to give way but nothing my fork and knife couldn't handle. I upgraded to sweet potato fries for an additional $3. They were worth every cent of the up charge and the extra calories! Can't wait to try new items next time, like the drunken crab poutine or their pizza.

This is hands down the best Italian in the city. My boyfriend and I make a point to come here every time we come to New Orleans because it exceeds our expectations. The small restaurant stays busy, so I would recommend making a reservation just to ensure you get a table. 10/10 come here!!!!

Hair found in my food.
Called and let management know once I opened the box at home. They refunded my meal and sent a gift card to apologize.
I love Martin's, but the service isn't great. I asked for my sauce on the side and I truly believe the hair was on the sauce container the cashier placed in the box. Even though they attempted to fix it, this was beyond gross.

We had trouble finding a parting space. But once we entered we were greeted by our server Eric.  He was so informative and walked us through the menu .  He had suggestions for our cocktails. 
We were really wowed !! 
We are from Texas but plan on coming back at the end of February and this will be on our list .  
Food was delicious and large portions. Loved the candles on the tables and the fire pit outside.

Best fish tacos!!!! That stuffed avocado is so delicious and innovative. I'll be back tomorrow for lunch! It was different. I loved it
Nice mojitos but a coconut  mojito!
Little cream of coconut and coconut rum!
Love this place. Italian style comfort food! Cozy spot and the BEST BUTTER CAKE...to die for!!
I've  been coming to PJ'S for 3 years. The food is excellent, service is great and waitresses  professional and attentive.

I saw Soulfed Philly on someone's food blog during a casual stroll down my Facebook timeline. I love seafood as I have stated in many other reviews so when I came to Philly I knew this was going to be a stop to be made. We originally went to the old location since the yelp information was outdated. With a quick google search we were able to find them a few minutes down the street. The stop we went to was takeout so you definitely want to keep that in mind so you will have arrangements made on where you plan to eat it at once you order. They are about to open a new location that will have seating at the beginning of August so keep an eye out for it. We ordered the #6 it can with 2 clusters of Alaskan crab legs and a good portion of shrimp. We also had broccoli and cord added to ours as well. for $40+ dollars it was plenty of food for two people and we brought our appetites. We weren't able to finish it all and trust me we tried. The food was made to order so it was nice and hot when we started eating. They don't skimp on the seasoning or the butter so there was a healthy amount of flavor on everything that came in the combo. We also ordered lemonade and the cups were huge. Actually perfect and refreshing during the 100+ temperature we had that day. The cashier was very nice and so were the cooks in the back. I felt like all of them really cared about our order and making sure we were happy with what we had. They made it a point to cater to us and that always says something abo

We had a very bad experience. Three different people served us and each person was somewhat rude. We each had a cup of Chicken & Andouille Sausage gumbo, which tasted good, but it had tiny pieces of 'debris' and no real chunks of either meat, and mostly rice. Then we received our dozen chargrilled oysters and they were superheated and overcooked. They quickly dried out as they cooled and were rubbery when chewing. We each tried two and then asked the waiter if we could have some new oysters less cooked. The manager came over with the tray of oysters and started rudely debating the degree of doneness. I always heard they were good, but my experience says no they are not. You can get much better food and service elsewhere.

I enjoyed my time here with my date. I was extremely hungry and annoyed because it was hot and the one in Philly was over an hour wait which was ridiculous. so we came here and was immediately seated. We was places outside in the tent because there were no seats inside apparently, however, the sun was still beaming on us. so we asked the waiter to move us which they were nice enough to do so into the shade where the picnic table was. Extremely nice of them. 

service was quick. we ordered two pitchers of electric blue long island. then we ordered the zingers and the nachos as appetizers. my date wanted ribs with fries which was hugeeee so definitely got our moneys worth. then we got the brownie ice cream which was hella sweet lol

Overall great experience and quick service. we shall return.  5 stars!

We came here for about the third time which happened to be summer solstice day in Santa Barbara. It was not crowded, and we were seated promptly at a nice outdoor table.

Second impressions are important: Iced tea. I was going to ask for lemon but then I saw a quarter of a thin lemon slice floating in the tea. Not the customary wedge. It would be rude to ask "can I have some lemon?" because they obviously think this tea HAS lemon. 

I ordered the Charlotte salad, described as having "seasonal fresh fruit, roasted walnuts, dried cranberries and bleu cheese." Sounds good. The actual salad was mixed greens with about 2-3 sliced strawberries on top, a very light sprinkling of bleu cheese, and so few candied walnut pieces that I couldn't see, let alone taste, them, and a few dried cranberries. Do they consider these little candied things roasted walnuts? The balsamic "vinaigrette" which was on the side tasted like pure vinegar and there was nothing (like roasted walnuts or bleu cheese) to offset it. Once I ate the strawberry/ies, I was done. The server asked me if I was "still enjoying it?" (code for are you done?) and I said "No I didn't care for it." and he said okay. 

The restroom was messy, water and paper on the floor, and no paper towels. 

My husband ordered a sandwich and a salad as his side. They brought the sandwich with fries. He didn't mention it and ate the fries. But we were charged to "upgrade" from fries to salad. They apologized and adjusted the bill. This is har

Good, solid food for when you are looking for a viable Chinese option. This is my go to in a pinch, and it's a reliable source of delivery on the weekend when the last thing I want to do is put on pants and leave the house. If you can identify, from this place you must buy!

I have been to his restaurant multiple of time and my husband loves this place his favorites orders are Kaju curry and butter garlic naan now even the waiter knows our order I would prefer you to try tomato soup also...The service is one of the best but me being a hard core vegetarian feel that they very less option other then that they have great music and environment...

The margarita pizza in Sicilian style: dough is thick but soft, nice crispy bottom and side crust. Good amount of tomato sauce. Very filling.

Veggie pizza: good amount of veggies and not overly cheesy.
Cheese pizza: good amount of cheese.
Both has nice crust, not hard or dry.

Garlic Parmesan wings are delicious: the Parmesan gives an umami flavor. 

Chicken salad is pretty big. Good amount of chunky chicken. Chicken was juicy and tender.
Got caddy's golden 'rita and it had not that much alcohol. And my burger was well over cooked. Terrible service and the staff have an attitude.

Good food but awful  service and behavior from staff! They always offer free soup with kitchen entree with the lunch menus but now for whatever reason they will try to bs you and charge more money. Will def getting my sushi craving from somewhere else. Can't be loyal to a place that will lie to you face even with mask on lol

Always friendly service and consistent food. I visit this location when I meet my daughter for dinner. She is obsessed with the rolls, which admittedly are very good - like morning biscuits with a buttery, cheesy taste. I typically get some combination of the wood-fired skewers of shrimp, scallops, and salmon with a house salad and side of broccoli.  The champagne vinaigrette salad dressing is so good like a citrusy Italian. My daughter gets the chicken Alfredo to go with her basket of rolls and always ends up taking a portion of both home with her. Overall, Good solid meal and very friendly service at a reasonable price.
If i could give zero stars i would. Refused to serve me. Just wanted some authentic food

Unfortunately, this is another example of a great place that has gone horribly downhill. 
It is sad that when bagels are to be toasted that they come out soft and gummy with no color change on the bagel implying toasting. 
It is also disappointing that the consistency is poor enough that my bagel had loads of cream cheese making it disgusting to eat, and my wife's bagel had so little cream cheese that when the halves were separated there were dry spots. 
The sun-dried tomato cream cheese used taste like sun-dried tomato and actually had tomato bits in it. Today's sun-dried tomato cream cheese tasted like black pepper and had no sun-dried  tomatoes in it.
I also used to be able to taste bacon in the bacon scallion cream cheese. But all I tasted today was salt. 
I am starting to rethink my loyalty to Blue Sky Bagels. There are other bagel shops in town. Albertsons sells some too and unfortunately those taste much better than the ones I was served.
I could eat this pizza, Stromboli's or garlic knots every single day! They are quick, friendly and have a wide variety of slices

Great service and very friendly staff.  Simple is simply an adorable ice cream sandwich shop that uses donuts as the bun.  Very tasty! 
The interior has a bunch of fun signage and Junkee collectibles to look at and it is attached to an junk consignment store.  
Well worth the visit! Ken Sarna recommends Simple Ice Cream Sandwich Shop in Reno

Great food! I was craving Thai food, even though I just came back from Thailand  Delicious food and actually spicy! How it should be! Lovely restaurant. Friendly staff. Great menu. All within a reasonable price. Highly recommend!
Melissa was our server and she did a wonderful job throughout our entire experience. The food was quick, tasted wonderful, and left me more than satisfied. We need more Melissas out there.

Their food isn't flavorful to me. They have a house made bbq sauce that tastes like straight up mustard. The collard greens and macaroni are extremely bland. The chicken was the only good part because I didn't add their house made bbq sauce.

I had been meaning to try Pumpkin in Philadelphia for quite some time. My friends and I got the prix fixe for three courses at $45. As a fairly priced meal, the first course of salt potatoes with crab is delicious and filling given the portion size. The second course of shrimp was not as strong and had a watery, tomato-based sauce with some greens. However, the shrimp was fully de-shelled properly and there was fine attention to detail, which I appreciated. My friend ordered the steak as a second course and was also underwhelmed, but the desserts were also great which ended the meal on a sweet note.

The panna cotta was just the right amount of sweetness and light. The olive cake for dessert was also delicious with exceptional presentation. I would visit pumpkin again to try the menu as it changes seasonally and overall think the meal was fair given the price point.

Well....theres only one thing I can say.....its trash!  I will never go back!

People were rude, managers were pushy, food was tasteless, good service is about the only thing I can say they have going for them. 

It's all a hype, if people follow it...hey, it's on them!

Not once have I ordered a chicken sandwich and asked for a different cheese that when I got my sandwich and was already home, they put the pepper jack on and still added the American. i couldn't even eat the sandwich.. very disappointing ...
The food was very good. Service-I felt invisible. Our server hardly came to our table. It wasn't busy at all and we waited over 30 minutes to even order. It was clean and well kept. Great location.

I keep hearing so much about The Joint Sushi, i went in to try it for lunch and a small company meeting but was very sad they only were doing reservations. My reason for the 5 stars is i seen the food that was being served and the facility smelled and looked very clean. The hostest was very nice in showing me what reservations were available unfortunately i wasn't able to make it back in i will try again soon.

I recommend ijji Sushi, just not this location. 

The sushi tastes great and looks fantastic. My poor rating is due to the service. After 20 minutes of waiting, we had to ask if we could order appetizers. The guy that was waiting on our table never said hello, thank you, is that all? or offered any help. He barely talked to us. We had our drinks empty for about 30 minutes before we got our ONE and ONLY refill of the night. The guy was on his phone all night. we put our empty drinks at the end of the table to get a refill and he looked over but didn't refill for another 10 minutes.  When we asked him for a list for AYCE sushi he walked away, I had to walk around and find a list at an empty table. 

I'm very understanding of busy nights, people coming in last minute (which I wouldn't ever do) and waiters having too much on their hands, but there were only 8 more customers at the restaurant and we came in 2 hours before closing, which I feel is still a reasonable time. If you want ijji Sushi, I would recommend the only on Kietzke and McCarran. They're busy most of the time, but the service is always going to be better than the experience I had.
Elegant rustic ambiance. Candlelight. Courteous staff. Nice array of drinks. Thoughtfully put together appetizers and entrees.

My brother and I enjoyed the best breakfast we've ever had in New Orleans. The owner was the most accommodating to our every need. The food was incredible and you can tell that it was made with love! Can't wait to go again next time we are in town!
Great location and good food! Menu had a good variety of California inspired dishes. Service was courteous and we had a wonderful breakfast. Highly recommend.

This is a beautiful hotel. The design of the interior is breathtaking with the inside balconies and the waterfall. The inside of the room is comfortable and cozy with a separate eating area and sitting area. there was some construction being done on the first floor and the doors where not working, which made it a bit difficult to bring in our luggage. But I would definitely stay here again

Extremely happy davincis is operating during covid. My favorite place with the best cocktails and food. Went for trivia night on Wednesday and had a great time with friends! Absolutely recommend to anyone
Amazing food, staff is always great! Steve and Mary are the best. We always have had great service.

I rarely leave reviews, but I also rarely receive such great service that I feel compelled to review. While I was dining at Felipe's, the Manager Luis stopped by the table to check on the quality of our food and the service provided to us. You never see restaurants do that anymore. Keep it up!

I had to find a bank for my grandma and she didn't want to go out to eat because she was mad that the grand ol opry isn't in it's original place that it was 50 something years ago. Eh, okay. I'm still going to eat with or without you. I was starving and passed this place going to the bank. They have dumplings, soups, and bao. I got an order of soup dumplings, pork and cabbage dumplings, and a steamed juicy steam bao. Tasty and hit the spot.
Best bowling alley in North Philly!  Amazing tots, sliders, drinks and staff.  There's two levels with bowling, pool and a few arcade and pinball machines.  Great for a group or even solo.
This place delivered food to my hospital unit for COVID. The food is freaking delicious and the cherry on top is that they support healthcare workers. Highly recommend this place

First and foremost...its a takeout or lunch place.  So dont expect tableside service.  Been coming here for 18 years...zero complaints.  When the kids come home from college..its Panda night.  On those cold winter nights...Lg Wonton Soup.  Its the best around.

I ordered from Millie's on two separate occasions before deciding to write a review and my experience with Millie's was the same each time.
First of all, the food took FOREVER to be delivered. After waiting nearly 90 minutes I called Millie's and I was told
that the food was on its way. Nearly 20 minutes later the food arrived but I was given the wrong food. I called Millie's to let them know that I was shorted an order of fries, the burger was the wrong one and one of the milkshakes were missing but after waiting nearly 2 hours, I was out of patience so I told the person at Millie's to forget it and I'll just keep what was delivered.
DO NOT ORDER FROM THIS PLACE !!!!! They are incredibly unprofessional and they are not capable of producing (and delivering) a product worth your money.



I am giving Millie's 1 star because the one milkshake they did deliver wasn't terrible. It's a shame that this place doesn't care more about the food they make or the customers they serve. 
Shame on you Millie's !!!!

We ended up making reservations here at the last minute, when the restaurant we were planning to go to was closed for COVID. There protocols are very safe, they have tables spaced out, wear maks and gloves, and take your temperature on arrival. The appetizers were amazing. We tried the pork buns and the dumplings. The sushi was good, but the appetizers were more flavorful and memorable. We tried mochi ice cream for dessert that was very good. Overall, I enjoyed the place, but the price was excessive for the quality of the food.

Such a delight! The food is delicious. The servers are very outgoing and prompt. The atmosphere is bright, chic and extremely clean. We had the breakfast bowl which is on their menue for a limited time. It was very fresh, healthy and delicious. 
In addition we use the Yelp app to put ourselves in the waiting line. Once we got there we were seated immediately. It was very helpful!
The waitress give me wrong order and charge me extra money. She did not feel sorry at all. I need to drive to there 3 times to get the items right and get my money back

Josh was our bartender and he was absolutely amazing :) Kevin came in shortly and he was still great with everything. I ordered a pitcher of their house Marg and Josh made it so so good :) I haven't had one that good in a while :) thank you guys!!!! I'll be back again soon :) :)

Stopped here during the Second Street Festival for chicken chorizo empanadas and margaritas. (We had had the empanadas the previous year in the tent outside and loved them.) We were seated relatively quickly and our waitress was really friendly. Our empanadas and margaritas were awesome! (I just wish the margaritas were a little bigger for the price.) I could see that they had a courtyard out back although it was much too warm to sit outside. Overall, we really enjoyed this place and would return.

Went for brunch recently with a group of five. We were sat at two different tables due to COVID restrictions, but they were sure to inform us of this when we called to make our reservation. I got the Smoked Salmon Benedict and it was the best breakfast I have ever had. Everything was so fresh and tasted amazing! Everyone else loved their meals as well. Bottomless mimosas were great too! Can't wait to go back again soon!

From the moment I started eating at Red Bowl, I have been returned to eat here every week. I am Chinese and I love authentic dishes. The food is awesome. Not only does it inspire me to come back frequently, but it has also encouraged me to cook more. The staff and service is great too!

I have given this place a chance three times and have come to the conclusion that it's overrated and very average. I'm sure at the beginning when this place opened the food was superb and that's what gave it it's notoriety and therefore grew into what it is today. But with most restaurants that grow quality and detail are lost and profits become the main priority. If it wasn't for tourists I I believe this place will take a big hit and most likely wouldn't survive overtime.
worst applebee's I've ever been to. service super slow when hardly any customers in restaurant. chips and salsa stale, fries dry.
